title: Belted Engression: Sufficient Dimension Reduction for Generative Distributional Regression
abstract: arXiv:2609.23789v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern conditional generative models face significant challenges when learning complex covariate dependencies. While sufficient dimension reduction (SDR) provides a principled approach to compress these dependencies, traditional SDR frameworks were not formulated for conditional generation. To bridge this gap, we propose Belted Engression, a unified and architecturally parameter-efficient framework for generative distributional regression. Our approach establishes an end-to-end compress-then-generate paradigm driven by sufficient representation learning, embedding a structural bottleneck into the generative architecture. Theoretically, we prove that the standard SDR condition is equivalent to a law-preserving generative factorization, which is achieved at the global optimum of the population Belted Engression objective. translated_title: 带式Engression：面向生成式分布回归的充分降维方法
translated_abstract: 现代条件生成模型在学习复杂的协变量依赖关系时面临重大挑战。虽然充分降维（SDR）为压缩这些依赖关系提供了一种有原则的方法，但传统的SDR框架并非为条件生成而设计。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了Belted Engression，这是一个统一且在架构上参数高效的生成式分布回归框架。我们的方法建立了一个由充分表示学习驱动的端到端“先压缩后生成”范式，在生成架构中嵌入了一个结构瓶颈。在理论方面，我们证明了标准的SDR条件等价于一种保持分布的生成式分解，该分解在总体Belted Engression目标的全局最优解处得以实现。此外，通过揭示能量分数损失的一种局部化Bernstein型控制，我们建立了有限样本一致性……
tldr: 该论文提出Belted Engression框架，通过在生成式分布回归中嵌入结构瓶颈实现充分降维，建立端到端的“先压缩后生成”范式，并从理论上证明了标准SDR条件等价于保分布的生成式分解以及有限样本保证。
en_tdlr: Belted Engression embeds sufficient dimension reduction into generative distributional regression via a structural bottleneck, establishing an end-to-end compress-then-generate paradigm with theoretical guarantees that the standard SDR condition is equivalent to a law-preserving generative factorization with finite-sample guarantees.
